transcript.text: Hi Elena and Marcus, thanks for joining this check-in. As we work toward closing this case, I want to make sure we capture a working agreement that reflects everything we need for the ongoing weekly information transfers between you two. Before I propose any structure, I'd like to hear from each of you: are there any concrete operating constraints or prior promises about how information should move between you week to week that you believe should be part of our formal working agreement? Please share anything that comes to mind, even if it was discussed informally before — this is the step where we make sure it all gets recorded accurately.
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I do have a concrete operating constraint I haven't raised yet. My workable boundary is that direct messages after 18:00 are not allowed; if something is urgent after that time, it needs to go to the shared project channel so I can respond during my agreed working hours. I didn't bring this up earlier because I expected the mediation to focus only on the handoff dispute, but since we're capturing the formal working agreement now, I want it recorded.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: There's a prior commitment I should put on the record. In a recent one-to-one with Elena, I informally agreed to send a written handoff checklist at least 24 hours before each information transfer and to hold one scheduled weekly coordination meeting. That commitment was never added to the case record, so I want to make sure it's captured formally in our working agreement.
transcript.speaker: A3
